newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle bid $104/dressed, passed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle bid $104/dressed, passed - USDA.

text.p: Trading on slaughter steers and heifers was at a standstill early Monday, USDA said.

Buyer inquiry fairly strong. Not all packers were bidding as yet, but a couple opened at $104.00 per cwt on a dressed basis. Many sellers priced cattle around the $106.00 level. Last established market on Thursday 104.00, few 105.00.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered ( paid on hot carcass weights ).
